title: Welcome To My Blog
text:
Hi, my name is Jason Bernstein. Welcome to my blog. I am thinking of writing short posts here on math and stats topics, like showing realizations of iterated Brownian motion or working through Project Euler problems.
A few important facts about me:

I live in the Denver metropolitan area
I am reading Jurassic Park
I like pizza with banana peppers and feta cheese
I collect stamps

And, scene.
